newsitem.title: USA: National Surgery sets 3-for-2 stock split.
newsitem.headline: National Surgery sets 3-for-2 stock split.

text.p: National Surgery Centers Inc said Thursday its board had declared a three-for-two stock split, to be distributed August 29, record August 15.
Cash will be paid in lieu of fractional shares.
National Surgery has about 12 million common shares outstanding.

"We are confident that the additional shares outstanding as a result of this stock split will benefit shareholders by increasing the company's trading activitiy and liquidity," E. Timothy Geary, chairman and chief executive, said in a statement.
National Surgery has a network of 34 outpatient centers in 12 states.
